Onevet Veterinary Clinic Carvalha

During the early morning hours of this cold day, my mother and I found a senior dog wandering aimlessly in the fields, quite weak. We picked up the animal and went to the Carvalha Veterinary Clinic without really knowing what to do.

The way the assistant and the veterinarian on duty attended to us, accompanied us, and helped resolve the situation was beyond excellent, with a great sense of empathy and humanity. It is attitudes like these that build customer loyalty and contribute to living in a much better world between humans and animals.

I am not a client of this clinic. After today, I will certainly become one.

After consultation and referral to the group's Hospital, I requested the medical report from the clinic so that my dog ​​could go to another Hospital for a CT scan. They made me wait 3 days. My dog ​​stopped walking, due to so much pain. I called the Carvalha clinic numerous times, and they replied that the veterinarian was not available. The professional's disinterest and insensitivity were clear.
Without a doubt, I will not return to the place, because although my pet has been followed by the clinic for about 9 years and is fortunate enough to have only had vaccinations/deworming, in this situation of need, the exploitation and speed when it came to referring to the group's Hospital (where the exams would be very expensive) and the deliberate disinterest when requesting a report of the consultation that I paid for, so that I could go to another Hospital, was clear.
The receptionist has nothing to do with this written portrait, she was always cordial and tried, as far as possible, to get the doctor to send the report. The veterinarian who reported for duty at the Carvalha Clinic on February 19, 2024 (I never met her) demonstrated a lack of professionalism, insensitivity, and disinterest. Working with animals is the same as working with people. Someone should explain to this lady that if she no longer enjoys the profession and isn't committed, she'd be better off working in a quarry. I believe that if it were one of her animals suffering from pain and unable to walk, she would certainly do something. In short, I strongly advise against her.
Excelent as always. Very kind and dedicated veteranairies, nurses and staff in general.
